element_title: Tree canopy and deep soil areas
title: Existing trees meeting the retention criteria are retained
text: Retention of existing trees on the site that meet the following criteria: healthy specimens with ongoing viability AND species is not included on a State or local area weed register AND height of at least 4m AND/OR trunk diameter of at least 160mm, measured 1m from the ground AND/OR average canopy diameter of at least 4m.

exceptions.label: removal of qualifying trees supported by an arboriculture report (A3.3.2)

notes: Applies where the site has an existing tree meeting the criteria (healthy and viable, not a listed weed, and at least one of height 4 m, trunk 160 mm at 1 m, canopy 4 m; Figure 3.3a). Exception: removal supported by an arboriculture report (A3.3.2) is read as an acceptable alternative, so the rule is NOT_APPLICABLE; A3.3.2 is also reported on its own. verify: whether A3.3.1 and A3.3.2 are alternatives is not stated.

verified.note: p31 does not say whether A3.3.2 (removal supported by an arboriculture report) is an alternative to retention; the criteria mix AND with AND/OR.
